mode: CONFIRMATORY for the primary questions (written before any AF3 selection result); Z2c / Z2m / Z4 / Z6 / Z7 / incumbent start are secondary
research_question: If the Z used by the Q-score is less accurate, does the rate of selecting the true family (Poisson vs COM-Poisson nu=2) fall, and do the errors go CMP2 -> Poisson?
hypothesis_not_assumed: true Z selects correctly; adding error to Z increases CMP2 -> Poisson
lineage: E-consistent per-column + PR #129 generic model (experimental prototype; not adoptable for the manuscript). PR #129 not merged; AF1/AF2 PRs (#166/#167) Draft

data.source: AF2 datasets regenerated with af2.generate(r) (PR #129 generator, unchanged)
data.check: x/y/z_true sha16 equal to AF2 fit_runs.csv for every fit

af2_states.check: sha256 equal to AF2 fit_runs.csv state_sha256 (200 files)

selector: family_selection_multisupport.score_candidate + select_column (unchanged); tie rule poisson first; complete log-pmf

start.primary: zero loading for both candidates (as PR #129 selector_only)
start.sensitivity: incumbent = the AF2 fit's own refit loading for that column

arms.Z2: true Z + s*eps, eps iid N(0,I) per sample, L=5, s in [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.45, 0.6], noise seeds [0, 1, 2, 3, 4] [PRIMARY]
arms.Z3: Oracle refit Zsamples, dense and sparse [PRIMARY]
arms.Z5: Support-only refit Zsamples, dense and sparse [PRIMARY]
arms.Z7: Auto (Poisson start) refit Zsamples [secondary; for column-level linkage to AF2]
arms.Z2c: true Z + one common draw s*eps, L=1 [secondary]
arms.incumbent_start: Z3/Z5/Z6/Z7 re-scored from the incumbent loading [secondary]

noise_interpretation: Q_j is invariant to any invertible linear map of Z applied to all samples (no intercept: f^T z = (A^-T f)^T (A z)), so rotation and global scale of Z do not matter for selection; translation would. s is the per-coordinate SD of an isotropic error on N(0,I) latent positions; for one draw the rotation-Procrustes RMSE is about s (audit/noise_level_interpretation.csv). The grid adds 0.6 to the proposed {0.1,0.2,0.3,0.45} because the Oracle per-sample RMSE is ~0.37 dense / ~0.56 sparse (audit/z_error_calibration.csv; Z geometry only, no selection result).
noise_seed_rule: np.random.default_rng([1664000, r, arm_code, level_or_regime_index, noise_seed]); arm_code 1=Z2, 2=Z2c, 3=Z2m
primary_metrics: Z2 noise level vs CMP2 -> Poisson misselection rate
secondary_metrics: per-observation score differences (descriptive Vuong-type z, conditional on the given Z; NOT a test)
per-sample margins (L=5 chain draws; NOT an MC standard error)
optimizer gradient, Hessian min eigenvalue, score-gap bound g^2/(2 lam)
statistical_unit: replicate (20 independent datasets). Columns within a replicate and noise seeds are averaged inside the replicate first; never counted as independent

aggregation.rate: per replicate: share of its 3 true-CMP2 (or true-Poisson) columns correct; Z2/Z2c/Z2m averaged over the 5 noise seeds inside the replicate; then mean over replicates
aggregation.dose_response: per replicate OLS slope of the seed-averaged CMP2->Poisson misselection rate on s (5 levels); mean slope with bootstrap CI and the count of positive slopes; Z1 is reported as s=0 but not used in the slope
aggregation.paired: Z5 - Z3 per replicate and regime (CMP2 misselection rate), bootstrap CI, sign counts

failure_rule: a FAILED candidate makes the column FAILURE (existing rule); it counts as not correct in every rate and is reported separately; nothing is retried, reseeded or excluded silently

reading_guide_predeclared.note: pre-declared guides for the next step, not significance tests; the thresholds are judgement aids without a formal statistical basis
reading_guide_predeclared.G1: Z1 true-CMP2 correct rate < 0.90 -> selector/candidate problem first
reading_guide_predeclared.G2: Z1 >= 0.90, Z2 mean slope > 0 with CI excluding 0, and >= 80% of Z2 errors are CMP2->Poisson -> Z error drives CMP2->Poisson (for this noise model)
reading_guide_predeclared.G3: Z3 CMP2 misselection >= 0.10 in a regime -> even Oracle-fit Z misselects -> S1 priority: selection robust to Z uncertainty (candidate-wise refit + predictive comparison)
reading_guide_predeclared.G4: Z3 CMP2 misselection <= 0.05 and Z5 - Z3 >= 0.10 -> incumbent-dependent q -> S1 priority: burn-in / outer cycle
reading_guide_predeclared.G5: >= 50% of Z3+Z5 misselections with |dQ| < 2 -> near ties -> stabilised selection (B) justified
